description: Gas Infrastructure Europe lists dedicated databases for LNG facilities, new LNG services, service offerings and gas storage. These are published infrastructure information products, with separate versions, not a single continuous operating-data feed. The provider is Gas Infrastructure Europe. Coverage: Coverage concerns European gas infrastructure. The page lists August 2026 versions for four products and October 2019 for the LNG investment database. Individual asset detail and update frequency vary by product. Access: The public provider page links to each database. File formats and individual tables were not inspected, and no files were obtained. Licence and cost: The overview does not state a reuse licence or complete charging conditions; these remain to be confirmed for each product. Limitations: The overview establishes the collection and version labels, but not field-level completeness or accuracy. For simulation, the databases can identify storage and terminal assets and inform gas-capacity scenarios, subject to checking the linked product documentation. Related resources: Related record data-gie-agsi-alsi-gas-storage-lng-transparency covers operational transparency platforms. Its inspected description and links do not cover this static database collection.
